Frequently Asked Questions

How does it get power?

It is USB powered. You can connect it to a USB charger, power bank, laptop or other compatible USB power source.

Can I use it as a normal night light?

Yes. It provides a soft light as well as the starry projection effect.

Where can I use it?

It works well in bedrooms, kids' rooms, study spaces, lounges and cozy corners.
